mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_after_sale (ticket_no, order_no, order_item_id, user_id, type, reason, status, source, handler_id, handle_remark, ai_generated, ai_confidence, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{ticketNo}, #{orderNo}, #{orderItemId}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{source}, #{handlerId}, #{handleRemark}, #{aiGenerated}, #{aiConfidence}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT INTO t_after_sale_flow (ticket_no, from_status, to_status, operator_id, operator_type, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{ticketNo}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorType}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_after_sale SET status = #{toStatus}, handler_id = #{userId}, handle_remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE ticket_no = #{ticketNo} AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT a.ticket_no, a.order_no, a.user_id, a.type, a.reason, a.status, a.source, a.handler_id, a.handle_remark, a.ai_generated, a.ai_confidence, a.create_time, a.update_time, i.product_id, i.product_name, u1.nickname AS user_name, u2.nickname AS handler_name FROM t_after_sale a LEFT JOIN t_order_item i ON a.order_item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN t_user u1 ON a.user_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN t_user u2 ON a.handler_id = u2.id WHERE a.ticket_no = #{ticketNo}

SELECT f.from_status, f.to_status, f.operator_type, f.remark, f.create_time, CASE WHEN f.operator_type IN ('AI', 'SYSTEM') THEN '智能客服' ELSE u.nickname END AS operator_name FROM t_after_sale_flow f LEFT JOIN t_user u ON f.operator_id = u.id WHERE f.ticket_no = #{ticketNo} ORDER BY f.create_time ASC, f.id ASC

SELECT a.id, a.ticket_no, a.order_no, a.order_item_id, a.user_id, a.type, a.reason, a.status, a.ai_generated, a.ai_confidence, a.source, a.handler_id, a.handle_remark, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM t_after_sale a JOIN t_order_item i ON a.order_item_id = i.id WHERE a.order_no = #{orderNo} AND i.product_id = #{productId} AND a.type = #{type} AND a.status IN ('PENDING', 'MANUAL_REVIEW') ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(ticket_no) FROM t_after_sale WHERE ticket_no LIKE CONCAT (#{dayPrefix},'%')
